digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate migration to shared discovery kernel
propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 currently collapses failed criteria to empty success and checkpoints without policy, prompt, contract, or topology inputs, losing operational context

The strategy adapter must compile existing Round-A discovery topology into DiscoveryStagePlan units and execute through S2 shared kernel while preserving YAML graph, concurrency, cache warming, and cancellation behavior
Failed local units cannot serialize clean checkpoints; earlier successes survive, independent work continues, dependents skip, and final verdict applies approved blocking policy
Checkpoint key must change on any material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependency, or namespace input change; legacy and corrupt entries produce zero reuse
Safe versioned trace stores in reducer-ignored review journal; review-plan and review-plan --status outputs contain only established end-result fields with no per-unit trace
